blocks.text: THE MYSTERY MAN— To some has only been seemingly like a phantom, but this sinister figure is real! — “The desolator cometh!” — It will only be a little while and he shall shew himself, although his personage is still couched in great mystery! — The one who confirms the peace covenant with Israel is alive today!” — The false prince shall surely unveil his plans and policy at the appointed and opportune time shall he make the agreement that is spoken of in, Dan. 9:27, “And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week: (7 prophetic years of peace and destruction) and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the

oblation to cease, and for the overspreading of abominations he shall make it desolate, even until the consummation, and that determined shall be poured upon the desolate.” — Isa. 28:15, calls it a covenant with death and with hell. — “But our covenant with Jesus is the gateway into eternal life, and beautiful scenes that no eye will ever imagine what He has for those who love Him!” — We see negotiations already unfolding forerunning the later appearance to confirm it.
THE CHURCH ELECT— Should really shout for joy, it’s one of

the greatest prophetic signs in over 2000 years revealing their departure is at hand! — I Cor. 15:52, “In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, we shall be changed and shall be gone!” — I Thess. 4:16, The Lord himself (Jesus) shall descend from heaven with a shout and with the voice of the archangel. (again Jesus is the angel of the Lord) — And He shall catch us away. (Acts 1:11) — God's revelations is just rolling like thunder as I write this! — Anybody with any sense can see that He couched Himself (as God) in These two separate Scriptures!

OLD THINGS BECOME NEW!— The past is coming back into our future! I said in the early 90’s I would reveal more that the Lord unveiled to me. — In prophecy he showed me 3 nests, that at first glance looked noble. The 3 forces had been sitting on the eggs. Then the Lord showed me the eggs began to hatch. And it revealed in this decade their plans are hatching forth! — Israel, the U.S.A. — Vatican (Babylon and all false churches) — Then He showed me a great iron horse, potent force of the West — USA-NATO — Western Europe would cause the world to come into a false peace in a short time after much strife! — “The great iron horse (spotted by gold) would finally go up to battle at Armageddon against the south wind, and the whirling winds of the north and east!” (After a great burst of prosperity, trademark and severe famine!) — The weapons foreseen are beyond anything that we have got. Absolutely using forces that we have not used yet! Using new atomic energy in different dimensions!” If God would not intervene we would not have a protective shield over the earth, it would all explode and burst!” — After this the Lord showed me the earth wobbling and splitting in places! The sun which came up in the morning was actually sunset at noon! Amos 8:9, reveals something similar to this! This all occurred because a great axis shift occurred because of a galaxy warp between several planets that hold the earth together including the sun, moon and etc.! (Isa 24:1 — Rev. 6:12-15) — The seas were completely out of order. It was what one would call a nightmare. “Thank God His children were gone!” In my opinion this century will see it all. I might add this, my feeling is California before this will already have its great catastrophic overthrow of cities into the sea! — I’m not trying to sound like a prophet of doom, but this is what the Holy Spirit is warning of and must obey! But I have real good news, God’s hands are coming upon His children as never before. “Fear not, saith the Lord, Only believe!” — Note: I might mention the North and South Pole regions had completely moved out of their sections. Such complete judgment from
God. This reminds me of Isa. 24:19.

COMING EVENTS— “Along the southern states’ shoreline off the Gulf of Mexico, the Lord revealed to me a great trembling and then shaking in the area and a tremendous amount of water! “And evidently could affect upward, eastward, downward into the Florida section! This could mean tremendous earthquakes and also storms of some kind in the future of this decade! — As Scripts said before,
also some sections of the United States from the tip of the northeast coast, down towards the midwest and plains, droughts will come

in various sections in this century! The shifting and movement of people to different states as I predicted has already occurred and with possible more to occur! (Evidently because of the earthquakes in California and the severe freezes in other states.) — A survey poll gave Phoenix as the 8th largest city with its surrounding areas.

Evidently it seem God is placing people in different states because of the migration that will take place during the soon coming Tribulation; so they can flee into the wilderness from the face of the serpent beast!
FOOD SHORTAGES— “Further up in the century Florida, and

California will suffer great crop destruction!” — Some in a small way has already occurred in an earlier prophecy! California is actually called the garden of the world, because of its corps; and probably Florida is secondary. Famine and floods have already caused some damage! But mighty quakes could also be involved.

THE COLD NORTH IN PROPHECY— (Ezek. chap. 38) — Russia later will receive a leader known as Gog in the Scriptures! He will be a worse tyrant than Stalin or Hitler! — “He will work with world trade and will be a deceiver!” In his heart he will try to overthrow the great dictator because of the great population that joins his side at the end!

WHAT ABOUT CHINA?— “I foresee a sinister and powerful figure who will rise in China and will influence all of Asia nearly, and possibly at the very end Japan!” No matter how good of friends they act like towards the USA now. This leader will be worse than Genghis Khan or the late Mao! — “God will give him an evil thought like Lucifer and he shall descend from the east.” About this time the worst drought and famine that the world has ever seen will have reached a peak! — “There will be food and great riches in the Middle East that brings him down, and Armageddon will start!” — But before and in between this we are entering an age of the most profound and significant events, the likes we have never seen before! (Read some of the last Scrolls!)

FUTURE STRANGE EVENTS— “The United States will shew forth some new discoveries and inventions a little later in the 90's.” — Science and mankind will witness some strange occurrences upon the earth that cannot be explained! — “Baffling events!” — Watch, God will give new celestial signs 1995 onward warning the earth! — Note: Over 30 years ago I saw and drew on a piece of paper the type of car that would be near the Translation! And just by coincidence I saw the prototype that’s coming, and it won't be long! (I will elaborate on this later). It was different than the car seen on the highway by another prophet. It was more of a car that you would use off an electronic highway, but it still may be one that you could use on a computer electronic radar highway too! — “Behold, saith the Lord, surely I come quickly.” (Rev. 22:20)
